title: Adaptive decision lattice for staged rollouts and eval-driven auto-quarantine
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an adaptive decision lattice that converts multi-dimensional eval signals (golden prompt scorecards, cohort drift metrics, latency & token-cost variance) into deterministic rollout actions for canaries, A/B experiments, and shadow traffic. The lattice is a rule graph that supports soft gating, hard quarantine, staged throttling and automatic rollback with hysteresis and noise-aware debouncing. This work ties together: (1) per-prompt weighted scorecards, (2) cohort-aware thresholds, (3) telemetry fusion across infra and quality signals, and (4) an action engine that executes model weight changes (0->X% traffic), isolated quarantine, or full rollback. The goal is to reduce manual intervention for quality regressions while minimizing false positives on noisy metrics.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Lattice can be configured via Console UI and API with at least three axes: quality delta, cohort drift, and infra risk
2) Scorecard ingestion supports per-prompt weights and dynamic sample priority; validation tests demonstrate per-customer thresholding works
3) An action engine circuit executes staged weight changes and supports emergency 'freeze' and 'quarantine' actions via API
4) End-to-end integration test that injects synthetic regression on golden prompts triggers quarantine within expected time window and auto-reverts when corrected
5) Telemetry exposes per-action provenance, latency, and token-cost delta in Console dashboards
technical_notes: Decision lattice representation: directed acyclic graph of predicate nodes (threshold tests) -> action terminals
Signal fusion: use z-score normalization per-metric with adaptive window (default 72h) to handle nonstationary workloads
Hysteresis: require consecutive N windows beyond threshold (configurable, default N=3) before hard action
Noise mitigation: Bayesian smoothing for low-sample prompts to avoid spurious quarantines
Action engine: idempotent operations with optimistic concurrency; persists action history to rollout-event-log for audit
